messages.subject: rstan: "CPP_stanc220 not resolved" after rstan and Rcpp updates
parts:
Hello everybody, 
I've just updated rstan and Rcpp and have got rid of the dreaded "index out of bounds" but now have this appearing all the time:

TRANSLATING MODEL 'mamodel' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
Error in .Call("CPP_stanc220", model_code, model_cppname) : 
  "CPP_stanc220" not resolved from current namespace (rstan)

Any advice? Here's the sessionInfo():

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan: "CPP_stanc220 not resolved" after rstan and Rcpp updates
parts:
I think it's because the old version of rstan is not removed completely.  So make sure you don't have an old version before installing a new one.

Jiqiang
